content.text: Crafting exceptional living spaces — a specialist developer delivering challenging, complex projects across retirement living, assisted care, and residential.
Redefining retirement & assisted living — Eden Projects is a specialist property developer with deep expertise in retirement living, assisted care facilities, and complex residential schemes.
We combine entrepreneurial thinking with institutional-grade execution.
Our unique team structure enables rapid decision-making while maintaining the highest standards of delivery.
From Grade II Listed buildings to Green Belt developments, we embrace complexity where others see obstacle.
We specialise in the delivery of challenging developments that demand expertise, creativity, and resilience.
Our entrepreneurial DNA sets us apart.
Local Understanding — Deep understanding of local demographics and needs, enabling diverse tenure and use class delivery.
Strong Partnerships — Close partnerships with principal contractors to ensure health and safety management and cost efficiency.
Sustainability — Embedded ESG is a key deliverable, actively supported by our investors and senior debt providers.
Complex Delivery — Experienced in Grade II and Grade II* Listed projects requiring extensive refurbishment and specialist planning.
Flexible Structure — Simplified decision-making process and agility to respond to changing economic conditions.
Bespoke Exit Strategy — Every project has a tailored strategy: Housing Association, Key Worker, BTR, Sales, or Shared Ownership.
